component.name: Frozen Bubble
component.summary: Pop matching color bubbles to clear the board, solo or online

description.p: A C++/SDL3 port of the classic Frozen Bubble 2: aim and fire bubbles to match three or more of the same color and clear them from the board. Play solo against the game's chain-reaction physics, locally with up to five players sharing keyboard and gamepads, or online against players on other machines.
